    "# This cell is removed with the tag: \"remove-input\"\n",

    "\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n"

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "92bf22dc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "(Tutorial_Principal_component_analysis)=\n",
    "# Principal Component Analysis\n",
    "\n",
    "*Computing covariance eigenvectors and eigenvalues to identify principal conformational motions.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.structure.principal_component_analysis` performs essential dynamics (PCA) by constructing and diagonalizing the Cartesian atomic positional covariance matrix across a trajectory, extracting the principal collective modes of conformational motion.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects of this function: {func}`molsysmt.structure.principal_component_analysis`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "21c14eab",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's show how to perform principal component analysis on a pentalanine trajectory (fitting frames first to isolate internal conformational dynamics from rotational/translational drift):\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "8759de0e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:13.402998Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:13.402563Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:14.662570Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:14.661419Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import pyunitwizard as puw\n",
    "import numpy as np\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "56e9ee76",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:14.665782Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:14.665360Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:23.959543Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:23.958270Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['pentalanine']['traj_pentalanine.h5msm'])\n",
    "molsys_fitted = msm.structure.least_rmsd_fit(molsys, selection='all', selection_fit='backbone', reference_structure_index=0)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ed90d4f0",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ":::{note} Demo Systems Catalog\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial uses demonstration datasets provided by MolSysMT. To explore the full catalog of bundled systems, forms, and file paths, visit the {ref}`Demo Systems <user-foundations-entrance-demo-systems>` guide.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "45b0be54",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We compute the covariance eigenvectors and eigenvalues for heavy atoms using {func}`molsysmt.structure.principal_component_analysis`:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "fd79b2e0",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:23.962792Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:23.962037Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:24.999808Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:24.998248Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "eigenvectors, eigenvalues = msm.structure.principal_component_analysis(molsys_fitted, selection='atom_type!=\"H\"')\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "8dc6ab69",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.003324Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.002937Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.009554Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.008171Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Eigenvectors shape (modes x 3*atoms): (90, 90)\n",
      "Eigenvalues shape (variances): (90,)\n",
      "Top 3 eigenvalues: [0.5964943862487921 0.14677595412969768 0.1194879104451236] nanometer ** 2\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print('Eigenvectors shape (modes x 3*atoms):', eigenvectors.shape)\n",
    "print('Eigenvalues shape (variances):', eigenvalues.shape)\n",
    "print('Top 3 eigenvalues:', eigenvalues[:3])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a9707cb9",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Cumulative explained variance and eigenvalue spectrum\n",
    "\n",
    "We compute and plot the individual and cumulative explained variance ratios to assess how many principal components capture the majority of the conformational motion:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "5f3bba3d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.012952Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.012578Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.364394Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.363028Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 900x450 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "eig_vals = puw.get_value(eigenvalues)\n",
    "var_ratio = eig_vals / np.sum(eig_vals)\n",
    "cum_var = np.cumsum(var_ratio)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(9, 4.5))\n",
    "plt.plot(range(1, 11), cum_var[:10] * 100, marker='s', color='darkorange', lw=1.5, label='Cumulative Variance (%)')\n",
    "plt.bar(range(1, 11), var_ratio[:10] * 100, color='royalblue', alpha=0.7, label='Individual Mode Variance (%)')\n",
    "plt.xlabel('Principal Component Index')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Explained Variance (%)')\n",
    "plt.title('Eigenvalue Spectrum and Explained Variance (Top 10 Modes)')\n",
    "plt.xticks(range(1, 11))\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.legend()\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "77ce9120",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Projecting structural ensembles onto principal components\n",
    "\n",
    "We project the trajectory structures onto the top two principal components (PC1 and PC2) to map the low-dimensional conformational energy landscape:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "418455cf",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.369329Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.368890Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:26.008829Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:26.007347Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x600 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "coords = msm.get(molsys_fitted, element='atom', selection='atom_type!=\"H\"', coordinates=True)\n",
    "coords_val = puw.get_value(coords, to_unit='nm')\n",
    "n_structures, n_atoms, _ = coords_val.shape\n",
    "flat_coords = coords_val.reshape(n_structures, n_atoms * 3)\n",
    "mean_coords = np.mean(flat_coords, axis=0)\n",
    "centered = flat_coords - mean_coords\n",
    "\n",
    "pc1_proj = np.dot(centered, eigenvectors[0])\n",
    "pc2_proj = np.dot(centered, eigenvectors[1])\n",
    "time = puw.get_value(msm.get(molsys, element='system', time=True), to_unit='ps')\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
    "scatter = plt.scatter(pc1_proj, pc2_proj, c=time, cmap='viridis', s=10, alpha=0.75)\n",
    "cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter)\n",
    "cbar.set_label('Time (ps)')\n",
    "plt.xlabel('PC 1 (nm)')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('PC 2 (nm)')\n",
    "plt.title('2D Conformational Subspace Projection (PC1 vs. PC2)')\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a620e6b3",
   "metadata": {},
